text.ASV: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
text.BSB: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
text.KJV: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

text.ASV: And God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
text.BSB: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
text.KJV: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

text.ASV: And God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
text.BSB: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning — the sixth day.
text.KJV: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

verses.theme: The first promise of a Savior

text.ASV: and I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed: he shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
text.BSB: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.”
text.KJV: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

text.ASV: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and be thou a blessing: and I will bless them that bless thee, and him that curseth thee will I curse: and in thee shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
text.BSB: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing. I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
text.KJV: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

text.ASV: And he believed in Jehovah; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.
text.BSB: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
text.KJV: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

verses.theme: Nothing too hard for the LORD

text.ASV: Is anything too hard for Jehovah? At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.
text.BSB: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you — in about a year — and Sarah will have a son.”
text.KJV: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

text.ASV: And Abraham said, God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son: so they went both of them together.
text.BSB: Abraham answered, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two walked on together.
text.KJV: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

text.ASV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
text.BSB: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”
text.KJV: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

text.ASV: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
text.BSB: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this— to preserve the lives of many people.
text.KJV: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

text.ASV: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
text.BSB: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
text.KJV: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

verses.theme: The LORD will fight for you

text.ASV: Jehovah will fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
text.BSB: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”
text.KJV: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

text.ASV: Jehovah is my strength and song, And he is become my salvation: This is my God, and I will praise him; My father’s God, and I will exalt him.
text.BSB: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
text.KJV: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

verses.theme: My presence will go with you

text.ASV: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
text.BSB: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
text.KJV: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

text.ASV: And Jehovah passed by before him, and proclaimed, Jehovah, Jehovah, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth;
text.BSB: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
text.KJV: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

text.ASV: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.
text.BSB: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
text.KJV: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.

text.ASV: Jehovah bless thee, and keep thee: Jehovah make his face to shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: Jehovah lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
text.BSB: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you; may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you; may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
text.KJV: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

text.ASV: God is not a man, that he should lie, Neither the son of man, that he should repent: Hath he said, and will he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and will he not make it good?
text.BSB: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
text.KJV: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

text.ASV: Hear, O Israel: Jehovah our God is one Jehovah: and thou shalt love Jehovah thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
text.BSB: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One. And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
text.KJV: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

text.ASV: Know therefore that Jehovah thy God, he is God, the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and lovingkindness with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
text.BSB: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
text.KJV: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

text.ASV: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by everything that proceedeth out of the mouth of Jehovah doth man live.
text.BSB: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
text.KJV: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

text.ASV: The secret things belong unto Jehovah our God; but the things that are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
text.BSB: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may follow all the words of this law.[’’]
text.KJV: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

text.ASV: Be strong and of good courage, fear not, nor be affrighted at them: for Jehovah thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
text.BSB: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
text.KJV: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

text.ASV: And Jehovah, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
text.BSB: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
text.KJV: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

text.ASV: The eternal God is thy dwelling-place, And underneath are the everlasting arms. And he thrust out the enemy from before thee, And said, Destroy.
text.BSB: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’
text.KJV: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

text.ASV: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate thereon day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
text.BSB: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
text.KJV: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

text.ASV: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of good courage; be not affrighted, neither be thou dismayed: for Jehovah thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
text.BSB: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
text.KJV: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

verses.theme: As for me and my house

text.ASV: And if it seem evil unto you to serve Jehovah, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve Jehovah.
text.BSB: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
text.KJV: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

text.ASV: And Ruth said, Entreat me not to leave thee, and to return from following after thee, for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge; thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God;
text.BSB: But Ruth replied: “Do not urge me to leave you or to turn from following you. For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live; your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.
text.KJV: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

text.ASV: There is none holy as Jehovah; For there is none besides thee, Neither is there any rock like our God.
text.BSB: There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You! And there is no Rock like our God.
text.KJV: There is none holy as the LORD: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.

verses.theme: To obey is better than sacrifice

text.ASV: And Samuel said, Hath Jehovah as great delight in burnt-offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of Jehovah? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
text.BSB: But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
text.KJV: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

verses.theme: The LORD looks on the heart

text.ASV: But Jehovah said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have rejected him: for Jehovah seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but Jehovah looketh on the heart.
text.BSB: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”
text.KJV: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

text.ASV: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.
text.BSB: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
text.KJV: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

text.ASV: and after the earthquake a fire; but Jehovah was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
text.BSB: After the earthquake there was a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a still, small voice.
text.KJV: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

text.ASV: And he answered, Fear not; for they that are with us are more than they that are with them.
text.BSB: “Do not be afraid,” Elisha answered, “for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
text.KJV: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.

text.ASV: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
text.BSB: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
text.KJV: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

text.ASV: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
text.BSB: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.ASV: Thine, O Jehovah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Jehovah, and thou art exalted as head above all.
text.BSB: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
text.KJV: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

text.ASV: if my people, who are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
text.BSB: and if My people who are called by My name humble themselves and pray and seek My face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.
text.KJV: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

text.ASV: For the eyes of Jehovah run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly; for from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
text.BSB: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth, to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose hearts are fully devoted to Him. You have acted foolishly in this matter. From now on, therefore, you will be at war.”
text.KJV: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

text.ASV: and he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat: Thus saith Jehovah unto you, Fear not ye, neither be dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.
text.BSB: And he said, “Listen, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem! Listen, King Jehoshaphat! This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.
text.KJV: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.

text.ASV: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto him for whom nothing is prepared; for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye grieved; for the joy of Jehovah is your strength.
text.BSB: Then Nehemiah told them, “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
text.KJV: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

verses.theme: For such a time as this

text.ASV: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then will relief and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place, but thou and thy father’s house will perish: and who knoweth whether thou art not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
text.BSB: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. And who knows if perhaps you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
text.KJV: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father’s house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

verses.theme: Blessed be the name of the LORD

text.ASV: and he said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: Jehovah gave, and Jehovah hath taken away; blessed be the name of Jehovah.
text.BSB: saying: “Naked I came from my mother’s womb, and naked I will return. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the name of the LORD.”
text.KJV: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

text.ASV: But as for me I know that my Redeemer liveth, And at last he will stand up upon the earth:
text.BSB: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
text.KJV: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

text.ASV: But he knoweth the way that I take; When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
text.BSB: Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.
text.KJV: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

text.ASV: I know that thou canst do all things, And that no purpose of thine can be restrained.
text.BSB: “I know that You can do all things and that no plan of Yours can be thwarted.
text.KJV: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.

text.ASV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.
text.BSB: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers. But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
text.KJV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

text.ASV: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.
text.BSB: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
text.KJV: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

text.ASV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained; What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?
text.BSB: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place — what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
text.KJV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained; What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

text.ASV: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
text.BSB: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
text.KJV: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

text.ASV: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
text.BSB: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
text.KJV: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

text.ASV: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in whom I will take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
text.BSB: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
text.KJV: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

text.ASV: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.
text.BSB: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
text.KJV: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

text.ASV: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.
text.BSB: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
text.KJV: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

text.ASV: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.
text.BSB: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
text.KJV: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

text.ASV: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
text.BSB: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
text.KJV: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

text.ASV: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.
text.BSB: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
text.KJV: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

text.ASV: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths. Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.
text.BSB: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths. Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
text.KJV: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths. Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

text.ASV: Jehovah is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?
text.BSB: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
text.KJV: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

text.ASV: Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah.
text.BSB: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
text.KJV: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

text.ASV: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.
text.BSB: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
text.KJV: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

text.ASV: For his anger is but for a moment; His favor is for a life-time: Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy cometh in the morning.
text.BSB: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
text.KJV: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

text.ASV: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
text.BSB: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
text.KJV: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

text.ASV: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.
text.BSB: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
text.KJV: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

text.ASV: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.
text.BSB: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
text.KJV: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

text.ASV: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.
text.BSB: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
text.KJV: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

text.ASV: Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart.
text.BSB: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
text.KJV: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

text.ASV: Commit thy way unto Jehovah; Trust also in him, and he will bring it to pass.
text.BSB: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
text.KJV: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

text.ASV: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.
text.BSB: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
text.KJV: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

text.ASV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, Who is the help of my countenance, and my God.
text.BSB: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
text.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

text.ASV: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
text.BSB: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
text.KJV: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

text.ASV: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
text.BSB: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
text.KJV: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

text.ASV: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.
text.BSB: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
text.KJV: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

text.ASV: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee: He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.
text.BSB: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
text.KJV: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

text.ASV: What time I am afraid, I will put my trust in thee.
text.BSB: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
text.KJV: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

text.ASV: Trust in him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. [Selah
text.BSB: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
text.KJV: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

text.ASV: O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.
text.BSB: O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
text.KJV: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

text.ASV: My flesh and my heart faileth; But God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.
text.BSB: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
text.KJV: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

text.ASV: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
text.BSB: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
text.KJV: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

text.ASV: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
text.BSB: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
text.KJV: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

text.ASV: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
text.BSB: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
text.KJV: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

text.ASV: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.
text.BSB: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
text.KJV: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

text.ASV: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
text.BSB: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
text.KJV: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

text.ASV: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:
text.BSB: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
text.KJV: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

text.ASV: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
text.BSB: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
text.KJV: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

text.ASV: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.
text.BSB: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
text.KJV: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

verses.theme: Bless the LORD, O my soul

text.ASV: Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
text.BSB: Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name. Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds —
text.KJV: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

verses.theme: As far as east from west

text.ASV: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
text.BSB: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
text.KJV: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

text.ASV: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
text.BSB: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.ASV: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
text.BSB: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
text.KJV: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

text.ASV: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.
text.BSB: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
text.KJV: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

text.ASV: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.
text.BSB: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
text.KJV: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.theme: My help comes from the LORD

text.ASV: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come? My help cometh from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
text.BSB: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
text.KJV: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

verses.theme: Your going out and coming in

text.ASV: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul. Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.
text.BSB: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul. The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
text.KJV: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

text.ASV: Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.
text.BSB: Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
text.KJV: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

text.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
text.BSB: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.
text.BSB: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
text.KJV: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

text.ASV: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts; And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.
text.BSB: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns. See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
text.KJV: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

text.ASV: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.
text.BSB: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
text.KJV: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

text.ASV: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
text.BSB: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
text.KJV: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

text.ASV: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
text.BSB: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
text.KJV: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

text.ASV: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.BSB: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
text.KJV: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of knowledge; But the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
text.BSB: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

text.ASV: Trust in Jehovah with all thy heart, And lean not upon thine own understanding: In all thy ways acknowledge him, And he will direct thy paths.
text.BSB: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
text.KJV: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

text.ASV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; For out of it are the issues of life.
text.BSB: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
text.KJV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
text.BSB: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

text.ASV: A soft answer turneth away wrath; But a grievous word stirreth up anger.
text.BSB: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
text.KJV: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

text.ASV: Commit thy works unto Jehovah, And thy purposes shall be established.
text.BSB: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
text.KJV: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

text.ASV: A man’s heart deviseth his way; But Jehovah directeth his steps.
text.BSB: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
text.KJV: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

verses.theme: A friend loves at all times

text.ASV: A friend loveth at all times; And a brother is born for adversity.
text.BSB: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
text.KJV: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

text.ASV: The name of Jehovah is a strong tower; The righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
text.BSB: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
text.KJV: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

text.ASV: There are many devices in a man’s heart; But the counsel of Jehovah, that shall stand.
text.BSB: Many plans are in a man’s heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
text.KJV: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

text.ASV: Train up a child in the way he should go, And even when he is old he will not depart from it.
text.BSB: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
text.KJV: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

text.ASV: Iron sharpeneth iron; So a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
text.BSB: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.
text.KJV: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

verses.theme: A woman who fears the LORD

text.ASV: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; But a woman that feareth Jehovah, she shall be praised.
text.BSB: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
text.KJV: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.

text.ASV: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
text.BSB: To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
text.KJV: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

text.ASV: He hath made everything beautiful in its time: also he hath set eternity in their heart, yet so that man cannot find out the work that God hath done from the beginning even to the end.
text.BSB: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
text.KJV: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

text.ASV: Remember also thy Creator in the days of thy youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
text.BSB: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth, before the days of adversity come and the years approach of which you will say, “I find no pleasure in them,”
text.KJV: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

text.ASV: This is the end of the matter; all hath been heard: Fear God, and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.
text.BSB: When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.
text.KJV: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

text.ASV: Many waters cannot quench love, Neither can floods drown it: If a man would give all the substance of his house for love, He would utterly be contemned.
text.BSB: Mighty waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love, his offer would be utterly scorned.
text.KJV: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.

text.ASV: Come now, and let us reason together, saith Jehovah: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
text.BSB: “Come now, let us reason together,” says the LORD. “Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.
text.KJV: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

text.ASV: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Jehovah of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
text.BSB: And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”
text.KJV: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

text.ASV: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here am I; send me.
text.BSB: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying: “Whom shall I send? Who will go for Us?” And I said: “Here am I. Send me!”
text.KJV: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

text.ASV: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
text.BSB: Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will be with child and give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel.
text.KJV: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

verses.theme: Unto us a child is born

text.ASV: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given; and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
text.BSB: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
text.KJV: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

text.ASV: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid: for Jehovah, even Jehovah, is my strength and song; and he is become my salvation.
text.BSB: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
text.KJV: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

text.ASV: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee; because he trusteth in thee.
text.BSB: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
text.KJV: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

text.ASV: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; but the word of our God shall stand forever.
text.BSB: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.”
text.KJV: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

text.ASV: He giveth power to the faint; and to him that hath no might he increaseth strength.
text.BSB: He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.
text.KJV: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

text.ASV: but they that wait for Jehovah shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; they shall walk, and not faint.
text.BSB: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
text.KJV: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

verses.theme: Fear not, I am with you

text.ASV: fear thou not, for I am with thee; be not dismayed, for I am thy God; I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
text.BSB: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
text.KJV: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

text.ASV: But now thus saith Jehovah that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed thee; I have called thee by thy name, thou art mine.
text.BSB: But now, this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
text.KJV: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

text.ASV: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
text.BSB: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
text.KJV: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

text.ASV: Behold, I will do a new thing; now shall it spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
text.BSB: Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
text.KJV: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

text.ASV: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
text.BSB: Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; your walls are ever before Me.
text.KJV: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

text.ASV: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace, that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation, that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
text.BSB: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
text.KJV: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

text.ASV: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities; the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
text.BSB: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
text.KJV: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

text.ASV: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and Jehovah hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
text.BSB: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
text.KJV: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

verses.theme: Seek the LORD while He may be found

text.ASV: Seek ye Jehovah while he may be found; call ye upon him while he is near:
text.BSB: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
text.KJV: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

text.ASV: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith Jehovah. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
text.BSB: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD. “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts.
text.KJV: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

verses.theme: My word will not return empty

text.ASV: so shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
text.BSB: so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.
text.KJV: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

text.ASV: and Jehovah will guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in dry places, and make strong thy bones; and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
text.BSB: The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
text.KJV: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

text.ASV: The Spirit of the Lord Jehovah is upon me; because Jehovah hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
text.BSB: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
text.KJV: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

text.ASV: But now, O Jehovah, thou art our Father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
text.BSB: But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are the potter; we are all the work of Your hand.
text.KJV: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

verses.theme: Blessed is the one who trusts

text.ASV: Blessed is the man that trusteth in Jehovah, and whose trust Jehovah is.
text.BSB: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
text.KJV: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.

verses.theme: Plans for a future and a hope

text.ASV: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith Jehovah, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope in your latter end.
text.BSB: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
text.KJV: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

verses.theme: Seek Me with all your heart

text.ASV: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
text.BSB: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
text.KJV: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

text.ASV: Jehovah appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
text.BSB: The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.
text.KJV: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

text.ASV: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and will show thee great things, and difficult, which thou knowest not.
text.BSB: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
text.KJV: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

text.ASV: It is of Jehovah’s lovingkindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning; great is thy faithfulness.
text.BSB: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
text.KJV: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

text.ASV: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
text.BSB: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
text.KJV: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

text.ASV: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
text.BSB: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
text.KJV: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

text.ASV: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of thy hand, O king.
text.BSB: If the God whom we serve exists, then He is able to deliver us from the blazing fiery furnace and from your hand, O king.
text.KJV: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.

text.ASV: For I desire goodness, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt-offerings.
text.BSB: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
text.KJV: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

text.ASV: and rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Jehovah your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
text.BSB: So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion. And He relents from sending disaster.
text.KJV: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

text.ASV: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of Jehovah shall be delivered; for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be those that escape, as Jehovah hath said, and among the remnant those whom Jehovah doth call.
text.BSB: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.[’’]
text.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.

text.ASV: But let justice roll down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
text.BSB: But let justice roll on like a river, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
text.KJV: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

text.ASV: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation is of Jehovah.
text.BSB: But I, with the voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You. I will fulfill what I have vowed. Salvation is from the LORD!”
text.KJV: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.

verses.theme: Do justice, love mercy, walk humbly

text.ASV: He hath showed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth Jehovah require of thee, but to do justly, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with thy God?
text.BSB: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
text.KJV: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

text.ASV: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth over the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in lovingkindness.
text.BSB: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance — who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
text.KJV: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

text.ASV: Jehovah is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that take refuge in him.
text.BSB: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
text.KJV: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

verses.theme: The just shall live by faith

text.ASV: Behold, his soul is puffed up, it is not upright in him; but the righteous shall live by his faith.
text.BSB: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright — but the righteous will live by faith —
text.KJV: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

text.ASV: Yet I will rejoice in Jehovah, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
text.BSB: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
text.KJV: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

verses.theme: He rejoices over you with singing

text.ASV: Jehovah thy God is in the midst of thee, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love; he will joy over thee with singing.
text.BSB: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
text.KJV: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

verses.theme: Not by might, but by My Spirit

text.ASV: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of Jehovah unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, saith Jehovah of hosts.
text.BSB: So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
text.KJV: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

text.ASV: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy king cometh unto thee; he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, even upon a colt the foal of an ass.
text.BSB: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
text.KJV: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

text.ASV: For I, Jehovah, change not; therefore ye, O sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
text.BSB: “Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
text.KJV: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

text.ASV: But unto you that fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings; and ye shall go forth, and gambol as calves of the stall.
text.BSB: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
text.KJV: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

text.ASV: And she shall bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name JESUS; for it is he that shall save his people from their sins.
text.BSB: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”
text.KJV: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

text.ASV: And he saith unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you fishers of men.
text.BSB: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
text.KJV: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

text.ASV: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
text.BSB: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
text.KJV: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

text.ASV: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
text.BSB: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
text.KJV: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

text.ASV: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called sons of God.
text.BSB: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
text.KJV: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

text.ASV: Ye are the light of the world. A city set on a hill cannot be hid.
text.BSB: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
text.KJV: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

text.ASV: Even so let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
text.BSB: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
text.KJV: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

text.ASV: but I say unto you, Love your enemies, and pray for them that persecute you;
text.BSB: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
text.KJV: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

text.ASV: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.
text.BSB: So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
text.KJV: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

text.ASV: for where thy treasure is, there will thy heart be also.
text.BSB: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
text.KJV: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

text.ASV: But seek ye first his kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
text.BSB: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
text.KJV: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

text.ASV: Be not therefore anxious for the morrow: for the morrow will be anxious for itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
text.BSB: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.[’’]
text.KJV: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

text.ASV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
text.BSB: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
text.KJV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

text.ASV: All things therefore whatsoever ye would that men should do unto you, even so do ye also unto them: for this is the law and the prophets.
text.BSB: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
text.KJV: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

text.ASV: Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
text.BSB: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
text.KJV: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

text.ASV: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
text.BSB: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
text.KJV: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

text.ASV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
text.BSB: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
text.KJV: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

text.ASV: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
text.BSB: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”
text.KJV: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

verses.theme: All things are possible with God

text.ASV: And Jesus looking upon them said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
text.BSB: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
text.KJV: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

text.ASV: And he said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the great and first commandment. And a second like unto it is this, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
text.BSB: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’ This is the first and greatest commandment. And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
text.KJV: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. This is the first and great commandment. And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

verses.theme: My words will not pass away

text.ASV: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
text.BSB: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
text.KJV: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

text.ASV: Go ye therefore, and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them into the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I commanded you: and lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world.
text.BSB: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
text.KJV: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

text.ASV: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe in the gospel.
text.BSB: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
text.KJV: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
