text.ASV: Straightway the father of the child cried out, and said, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
text.BSB: Immediately the boy’s father cried out, “I do believe; help my unbelief!”
text.KJV: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

verses.theme: To serve and to give His life

text.ASV: For the Son of man also came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
text.BSB: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
text.KJV: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

text.ASV: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
text.BSB: And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
text.KJV: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

text.ASV: For no word from God shall be void of power.
text.BSB: For no word from God will ever fail.”
text.KJV: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

text.ASV: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord, And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
text.BSB: Then Mary said: “My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!
text.KJV: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord, And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

text.ASV: And the angel said unto them, Be not afraid; for behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy which shall be to all the people: for there is born to you this day in the city of David a Saviour, who is Christ the Lord.
text.BSB: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
text.KJV: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

verses.theme: Glory to God in the highest

text.ASV: Glory to God in the highest, And on earth peace among men in whom he is well pleased.
text.BSB: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!”
text.KJV: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

text.ASV: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
text.BSB: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
text.KJV: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

verses.theme: Give, and it will be given

text.ASV: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, shall they give into your bosom. For with what measure ye mete it shall be measured to you again.
text.BSB: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.”
text.KJV: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

text.ASV: And he said unto all, If any man would come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
text.BSB: Then Jesus said to all of them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
text.KJV: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

text.ASV: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
text.BSB: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.
text.KJV: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

verses.theme: To seek and to save the lost

text.ASV: For the Son of man came to seek and to save that which was lost.
text.BSB: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”
text.KJV: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

text.ASV: And Jesus said, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And parting his garments among them, they cast lots.
text.BSB: Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.” And they divided up His garments by casting lots.
text.KJV: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

text.ASV: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
text.BSB: He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:
text.KJV: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

verses.theme: In the beginning was the Word

text.ASV: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
text.BSB: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
text.KJV: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

text.ASV: But as many as received him, to them gave he the right to become children of God, even to them that believe on his name:
text.BSB: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God —
text.KJV: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

text.ASV: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us (and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father), full of grace and truth.
text.BSB: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
text.KJV: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

text.ASV: On the morrow he seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold, the Lamb of God, that taketh away the sin of the world!
text.BSB: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
text.KJV: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

text.KJV: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

text.ASV: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
text.BSB: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
text.KJV: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

text.BSB: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
text.KJV: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

text.BSB: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
text.KJV: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

text.ASV: All that which the Father giveth me shall come unto me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

text.KJV: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

text.KJV: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

verses.theme: The truth will set you free

text.ASV: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
text.BSB: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
text.KJV: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

text.ASV: If therefore the Son shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
text.BSB: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
text.KJV: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

text.ASV: The thief cometh not, but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
text.BSB: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
text.KJV: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

text.ASV: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.
text.BSB: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
text.KJV: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

text.ASV: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me: and I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, and no one shall snatch them out of my hand.
text.BSB: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me. I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
text.KJV: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

text.ASV: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth on me, though he die, yet shall he live; and whosoever liveth and believeth on me shall never die. Believest thou this?
text.BSB: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies. And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
text.KJV: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

text.KJV: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another. By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

verses.theme: Let not your heart be troubled

text.ASV: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.
text.BSB: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
text.KJV: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

verses.theme: The way, the truth and the life

text.ASV: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.
text.BSB: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
text.KJV: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

text.ASV: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
text.BSB: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
text.KJV: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

text.ASV: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.
text.BSB: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
text.KJV: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

text.ASV: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
text.BSB: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
text.KJV: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

text.ASV: These things have I spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

text.KJV: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

text.ASV: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, even Jesus Christ.
text.BSB: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
text.KJV: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

text.ASV: Sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.
text.BSB: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
text.KJV: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

text.ASV: but these are written, that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye may have life in his name.

text.KJV: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

text.ASV: But ye shall receive power, when the Holy Spirit is come upon you: and ye shall be my witnesses both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa and Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
text.BSB: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
text.KJV: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

text.KJV: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

text.KJV: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

text.ASV: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus, and thou shalt be saved, thou and thy house.
text.BSB: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
text.KJV: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

text.ASV: for in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain even of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

text.KJV: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

text.BSB: But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus — the ministry of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
text.KJV: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

text.BSB: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.
text.KJV: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

verses.theme: The righteous shall live by faith

text.BSB: For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”
text.KJV: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

text.ASV: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
text.BSB: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
text.KJV: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

text.ASV: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
text.BSB: and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

text.BSB: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
text.KJV: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

text.ASV: But God commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
text.BSB: But God proves His love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
text.KJV: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

text.ASV: For the wages of sin is death; but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.BSB: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.KJV: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

text.BSB: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

text.ASV: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed to us-ward.
text.BSB: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
text.KJV: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

text.ASV: And in like manner the Spirit also helpeth our infirmity: for we know not how to pray as we ought; but the Spirit himself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered;
text.BSB: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
text.KJV: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

text.BSB: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
text.KJV: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

text.ASV: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
text.BSB: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
text.KJV: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

text.BSB: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.KJV: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text.ASV: because if thou shalt confess with thy mouth Jesus as Lord, and shalt believe in thy heart that God raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved:
text.BSB: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
text.KJV: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

text.ASV: So belief cometh of hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
text.BSB: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
text.KJV: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

text.ASV: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
text.BSB: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
text.KJV: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

text.BSB: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
text.KJV: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

text.BSB: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
text.KJV: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

text.ASV: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing stedfastly in prayer;
text.BSB: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
text.KJV: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

text.ASV: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
text.BSB: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
text.KJV: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

text.KJV: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

text.KJV: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

text.BSB: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
text.KJV: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

text.BSB: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
text.KJV: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.

text.KJV: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.

text.KJV: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

text.KJV: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

text.KJV: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

text.KJV: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

text.BSB: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

text.KJV: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

text.KJV: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

text.BSB: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
text.KJV: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

text.ASV: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.
text.BSB: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
text.KJV: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

text.ASV: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, meekness, self-control; against such there is no law.
text.BSB: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
text.KJV: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

text.ASV: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
text.BSB: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
text.KJV: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

text.ASV: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
text.BSB: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
text.KJV: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

text.ASV: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
text.BSB: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
text.KJV: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

text.ASV: for by grace have ye been saved through faith; and that not of yourselves, it is the gift of God; not of works, that no man should glory.
text.BSB: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast.
text.KJV: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

text.ASV: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God afore prepared that we should walk in them.
text.BSB: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
text.KJV: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

text.ASV: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
text.BSB: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
text.KJV: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

text.ASV: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for edifying as the need may be, that it may give grace to them that hear.
text.BSB: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
text.KJV: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

text.ASV: and be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, even as God also in Christ forgave you.
text.BSB: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
text.KJV: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

text.ASV: and walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for an odor of a sweet smell.
text.BSB: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
text.KJV: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

text.ASV: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
text.BSB: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
text.KJV: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

text.ASV: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
text.BSB: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.
text.KJV: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

verses.theme: He who began a good work

text.ASV: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Jesus Christ:
text.BSB: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

text.ASV: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
text.BSB: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
text.KJV: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

text.ASV: doing nothing through faction or through vainglory, but in lowliness of mind each counting other better than himself;
text.BSB: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
text.KJV: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

text.ASV: that in the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven and things on earth and things under the earth, and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
text.BSB: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth, and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
text.KJV: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

text.ASV: I press on toward the goal unto the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
text.BSB: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

text.ASV: Rejoice in the Lord always: again I will say, Rejoice.
text.BSB: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
text.KJV: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

text.ASV: In nothing be anxious; but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
text.BSB: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

text.ASV: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honorable, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
text.BSB: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — if anything is excellent or praiseworthy — think on these things.
text.KJV: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

text.ASV: I can do all things in him that strengtheneth me.
text.BSB: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
text.KJV: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

text.ASV: And my God shall supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
text.BSB: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

verses.theme: In Him all things hold together

text.ASV: and he is before all things, and in him all things consist.
text.BSB: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
text.KJV: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

verses.theme: Set your mind on things above

text.ASV: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are upon the earth.
text.BSB: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
text.KJV: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

text.ASV: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to the which also ye were called in one body; and be ye thankful.
text.BSB: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
text.KJV: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

verses.theme: Work heartily, as for the Lord

text.ASV: whatsoever ye do, work heartily, as unto the Lord, and not unto men;
text.BSB: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, as for the Lord and not for men,
text.KJV: And what soever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

text.ASV: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.
text.BSB: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
text.KJV: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

text.ASV: Rejoice always; pray without ceasing; in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.
text.BSB: Rejoice at all times. Pray without ceasing. Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
text.KJV: Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

verses.theme: He who calls you is faithful

text.ASV: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.
text.BSB: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
text.KJV: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

text.ASV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and guard you from the evil one.
text.BSB: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
text.KJV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

text.ASV: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
text.BSB: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
text.KJV: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

text.ASV: Faithful is the saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief:
text.BSB: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
text.KJV: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

text.ASV: For there is one God, one mediator also between God and men, himself man, Christ Jesus,
text.BSB: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
text.KJV: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

text.ASV: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an ensample to them that believe, in word, in manner of life, in love, in faith, in purity.
text.BSB: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
text.KJV: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

text.ASV: But godliness with contentment is great gain:
text.BSB: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
text.KJV: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

text.ASV: Fight the good fight of the faith, lay hold on the life eternal, whereunto thou wast called, and didst confess the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
text.BSB: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.
text.KJV: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, where unto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

verses.theme: Power, love and a sound mind

text.ASV: For God gave us not a spirit of fearfulness; but of power and love and discipline.
text.BSB: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
text.KJV: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

text.ASV: Give diligence to present thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, handling aright the word of truth.
text.BSB: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
text.KJV: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

text.ASV: Every scripture inspired of God is also profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, for instruction which is in righteousness: that the man of God may be complete, furnished completely unto every good work.
text.BSB: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness, so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
text.KJV: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

text.ASV: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith:
text.BSB: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
text.KJV: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

text.ASV: For the grace of God hath appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
text.BSB: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
text.KJV: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

text.ASV: not by works done in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,
text.BSB: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
text.KJV: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

text.ASV: For I had much joy and comfort in thy love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through thee, brother.
text.BSB: I take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.
text.KJV: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

verses.theme: The word is living and active

text.ASV: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and quick to discern the thoughts and intents of the heart.
text.BSB: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
text.KJV: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

text.ASV: Let us therefore draw near with boldness unto the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace to help us in time of need.
text.BSB: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
text.KJV: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

text.ASV: let us hold fast the confession of our hope that it waver not; for he is faithful that promised:
text.BSB: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.
text.KJV: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

verses.theme: Stir up love and good works

text.ASV: and let us consider one another to provoke unto love and good works;
text.BSB: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.
text.KJV: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

text.ASV: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, a conviction of things not seen.
text.BSB: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
text.KJV: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

text.ASV: and without faith it is impossible to be well-pleasing unto him; for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that seek after him.
text.BSB: And without faith it is impossible to please God. For anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
text.KJV: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

text.ASV: looking unto Jesus the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising shame, and hath sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
text.BSB: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
text.KJV: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

text.ASV: Be ye free from the love of money; content with such things as ye have: for himself hath said, I will in no wise fail thee, neither will I in any wise forsake thee.
text.BSB: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
text.KJV: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

verses.theme: The same yesterday, today and forever

text.ASV: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and to-day, yea and for ever.
text.BSB: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
text.KJV: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

text.ASV: Count it all joy, my brethren, when ye fall into manifold temptations; knowing that the proving of your faith worketh patience.
text.BSB: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
text.KJV: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

text.ASV: But if any of you lacketh wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth to all liberally and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
text.BSB: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
text.KJV: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

text.ASV: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, neither shadow that is cast by turning.
text.BSB: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
text.KJV: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

text.ASV: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deluding your own selves.
text.BSB: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
text.KJV: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

text.ASV: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye doubleminded.
text.BSB: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
text.KJV: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

text.ASV: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall exalt you.
text.BSB: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
text.KJV: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

text.ASV: Confess therefore your sins one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man availeth much in its working.
text.BSB: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
text.KJV: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

text.ASV: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
text.BSB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
text.KJV: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

text.ASV: But ye are an elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
text.BSB: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
text.KJV: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

verses.theme: By His wounds you were healed

text.ASV: who his own self bare our sins in his body upon the tree, that we, having died unto sins, might live unto righteousness; by whose stripes ye were healed.
text.BSB: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”
text.KJV: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.

verses.theme: Be ready to give an answer

text.ASV: but sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord: being ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with meekness and fear:
text.BSB: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
text.KJV: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

text.ASV: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.
text.BSB: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
text.KJV: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

text.ASV: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.
text.BSB: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
text.KJV: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

verses.theme: All things for life and godliness

text.ASV: seeing that his divine power hath granted unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that called us by his own glory and virtue;
text.BSB: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
text.KJV: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

text.ASV: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some count slackness; but is longsuffering to you-ward, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
text.BSB: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
text.KJV: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

text.ASV: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and for ever. Amen.
text.BSB: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
text.KJV: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

text.ASV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text.BSB: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text.KJV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

text.ASV: Behold what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called children of God; and such we are. For this cause the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
text.BSB: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
text.KJV: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

verses.theme: Greater is He who is in you

text.ASV: Ye are of God, my little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world.
text.BSB: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
text.KJV: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

text.ASV: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
text.BSB: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
text.KJV: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

text.ASV: There is no fear in love: but perfect love casteth out fear, because fear hath punishment; and he that feareth is not made perfect in love.
text.BSB: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
text.KJV: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

verses.theme: We love because He first loved us

text.ASV: We love, because he first loved us.
text.BSB: We love because He first loved us.
text.KJV: We love him, because he first loved us.

text.ASV: And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us:
text.BSB: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
text.KJV: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

text.ASV: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.
text.BSB: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
text.KJV: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

verses.theme: Able to keep you from stumbling

text.ASV: Now unto him that is able to guard you from stumbling, and to set you before the presence of his glory without blemish in exceeding joy, to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, dominion and power, before all time, and now, and for evermore. Amen.
text.BSB: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy — to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
text.KJV: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

text.ASV: I am the Alpha and the Omega, saith the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
text.BSB: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come — the Almighty.
text.KJV: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

verses.theme: I stand at the door and knock

text.ASV: Behold, I stand at the door and knock: if any man hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
text.BSB: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
text.KJV: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

text.ASV: Worthy art thou, our Lord and our God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power: for thou didst create all things, and because of thy will they were, and were created.
text.BSB: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and were created.”
text.KJV: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

text.ASV: and he shall wipe away every tear from their eyes; and death shall be no more; neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more: the first things are passed away.
text.BSB: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
text.KJV: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

text.ASV: And he that sitteth on the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he saith, Write: for these words are faithful and true.
text.BSB: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
text.KJV: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

text.ASV: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
text.BSB: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
text.KJV: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
